subject.title: Feature Request: Anthropic Context Management Beta Passthrough

question: Should the remaining Anthropic context-management work stay as one umbrella item, or be split into provider-native compaction, context editing, and Memory Tool/plugin-seam tracks?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent public config/API shape and the Memory Tool filesystem security boundary require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Split by boundary
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10213 for provider-native compaction, keep this issue for context-editing/shared API design, and keep Memory Tool work plugin-owned unless a core seam is missing.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the single design item for compaction, context editing, beta payloads, and Memory Tool, accepting a broader and harder-to-review implementation path.

options.title: Close after replacement trackers
options.body: Create or designate canonical items for every remaining slice, then close this umbrella once no unique context remains.

recommendation.title: Split by boundary
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10213 for provider-native compaction, keep this issue for context-editing/shared API design, and keep Memory Tool work plugin-owned unless a core seam is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the affected Anthropic/provider and compaction-policy surfaces.
